title: kv-cache: memory eviction + spillover + defrag heuristics v22
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Context: KV cache memory pressure continues to be a dominant cause of tail latency and OOMs on mixed workloads. Previous iterations focused on eviction priority and basic spillover. This PR introduces a combined approach: compact-on-hot-evict, adaptive paging thresholds, fragmentation-aware free-list coalescing, and scheduler hints to avoid evicting actively used KV shards during continuous batching windows. Motivation: further reduce tail latency and OOM incidents under high-concurrency streaming inference while improving cache hit stability across sequence-length distributions. Changes: 1) new compact_on_eviction flag that attempts lightweight coalescing of adjacent free extents when evicting large entries, with a configurable CPU budget; 2) adaptive_paging_threshold that moves from in-memory KV to paging earlier for cold infrequent sequences while keeping hot prefixes resident; 3) fragmentation_score per shard to guide both eviction priority and background compaction; 4) spillover_manager that batches paging writes to reduce IO spikes and coordinates with the serving scheduler to defer compaction during tight latency windows; 5) scheduler integration: eviction hints allow the request scheduler to prefer routing to nodes with lower fragmentation_score for long-context requests; 6) telemetry: new metrics kv.fragmentation_score, kv.compaction_runs, kv.spill.batch_size, kv.paging_io_latency; 7) a safety mode that, on sustained high-paging_io_latency, temporarily widens batching windows and reduces compaction aggressiveness. Testing: microbenchmarks showing median token latency +/-1% and p95 reduced by 8-12% on mixed short+long stream traces, memory footprint reduced by ~18% for long-context synthetic traces, and e2e soak tests for 72h with no OOMs under a 5K RPS mixed workload. Rollout plan: feature-flagged and gated behind config kv_eviction_v22; staged rollout to Dedicated pools then Hosted after 2 weeks of stability metrics. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for free-list and fragmentation scoring - [x] Integration tests with spillover manager and scheduler hints - [x] Telemetry dashboards updated - [x] Benchmarks attached - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Docs note in runtime/kv-cache.md Related: builds on work from ENG-3120 and PRs that introduced basic spillover and defrag scheduler hooks. Breaking change: no.

release_notes: Improves KV cache memory management by introducing fragmentation-aware eviction, adaptive paging thresholds, compact-on-evict, and coordinated spillover batching. Expected benefits: reduced p95 token latency by ~8-12% on mixed workloads and reduced memory footprint for long-context workloads. Rollout is feature-flagged.
